title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-135-25二模

items.zh: 夕阳染红了半边天空,真是赏心悦目。
items.en: The sunset dyed half of the sky red, engaging viewers with its breathtaking beauty.

items.zh: 豆腐营养丰富且容易消化，老少咸宜。
items.en: Tofu is rich in nutrition and easy to digest, perfect for all ages.

items.zh: 池塘边石柱上的精美雕刻体现了人与自然和谐共生的理念。
items.en: The exquisite carvings on the stone pillars by the pond reflect the belief in the harmonious coexistence between humans and nature.

items.zh: 邻居阿婆原本觉得美图软件这类新潮玩意儿用起来会很麻烦，但跟着侄女没学几次就能自如地给照片改色调了。
items.en: The elderly neighbor originally thought of trendy apps like photo editors as a hassle to use, but after just a few tries with her niece, she was already adjusting photo tones with ease.
